terms.meaning: The written instructions sent to the AI model describing the task.
The choice of AI service and its key, passed in from the app.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and time limit
sections.what: Brings in the request tools and AI helper, and allows up to 120 seconds for the request.
sections.why: AI calls can be slow, so the longer limit prevents early timeouts.

sections.name: DiscoveredCompany
sections.title: Company record shape
sections.what: Describes one suggested company: name, regions, sector, careers link, reason, and seniority fit.
sections.why: Gives the code a fixed shape to read the AI result into.
sections.watch_out: Types are not checked when the code runs, so the AI can still return the wrong shape.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Build the recommendation prompt
sections.what: Reads the profile and writes the prompt that tells the AI which companies to suggest and the rules to follow.
sections.why: Tailors the suggestions to the candidate's background and region.
sections.watch_out: Missing profile fields become empty text, which weakens the prompt without warning.

sections.name: POST (part 2)
sections.title: Ask the AI for companies
sections.what: Sends the prompt to the AI, reads the JSON reply, and returns the companies it suggests.
sections.why: Completes the request for the app.
sections.watch_out: The reply is capped at 4000 tokens, so a large count can be cut off and produce invalid JSON.

summary: Asks the AI for a list of target companies that fit the candidate's profile.
purpose: Helps the user find companies to apply to.
why: Likely reason: saves the user research time.
how: Reads the profile, builds a prompt with the profile, region preference, and sector and seniority rules, asks the AI for JSON, then returns the companies list.
inputs: A profile object, optional provider settings, a count (default 25), and an optional region.
outputs: A companies list, or an error message with status 400 or 500.
risks: The AI output is not checked against the expected shape, so bad replies can produce odd results. The AI may invent companies or careers links that do not exist.
debug: An empty list: check the AI reply through chatJSON. A 500 error: check the provider settings and the API key.
